vipCitation.title: PharmGKB VIP Summary: DPYD
vipCitation.notes: This document contains text that was found on the PharmGKB VIP page for DPYD prior to Oct 2024.

vipSummary.html:
DPYD is one of the key pharmacogenes involved in the implementation of pharmacogenomics.

                            - It is involved in guidelines for [fluorouracil](/guidelineAnnotation/PA166122686) and [capecitabine](/guidelineAnnotation/PA166109594) ([go to list of all guidelines with DPYD](/gene/PA145/prescribingInfo)).
                            - the nomenclature has been set by [PharmVar](https://www.pharmvar.org/gene/DPYD)
                              - the key variants are tier 1 [allele:DPYD c.1905+1G>A (\*2A)], [allele:DPYD c.1679T>G (\*13)], [allele:DPYD c.1129-5923C>G, c.1236G>A (HapB3)], [allele:DPYD c.557A>G], [allele:DPYD c.868A>G], [allele:DPYD c.2279C>T], [allele:DPYD c.2846A>T] , and tier 2 [allele: DPYD c.295_298delTCAT (\*7)], [allele: DPYD c.703C>T (\*8)], [allele: DPYD c.1314T>G], [allele: DPYD c.1475C>T], [allele: DPYD c.1774C>T],[allele: DPYD c.2639G>T] [PMID:39032821] [see all alleles on the AMP recommended to test list](/ampAllelesToTest).
                              - See the [Gene-specific Information Tables](/page/dpydRefMaterials) for Allele Definitions (for which variants comprise which star alleles), Allele function assignments (normal function, no function, decreased or increased function etc) and Diplotype-Phenotype Table (for how the alleles combine to form metabolizer phenotypes for PM, NM, UM)
